notes.title: Demo Update (v2.0)
notes.notes:
Feature Additions

 Two new ranged units have been added.
 A new magic type attack has been added.
 New skills have been added to characters that previously had none.
 The final boss for stage 31 has been added.
 Defeated enemies now disappear from the map.
 An item grade system has been added.
 The looting system during battles has been removed and changed so that looting occurs on the hiring screen.
 A brief battle history is displayed upon winning the final battle.

notes.title: Demo Update (v2.0)
notes.notes:
Feature Additions

 Added a friend-or-foe indicator to display characters' health above their heads.
 Enemy hero characters now use skills.
 Adjusted the aggro system to prevent the issue where characters would bunch up and chase a single enemy.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed various issues that caused the game to halt progress in the middle of a stage.


Balancing Adjustments

 Overall difficulty has been increased, and spikes in difficulty have been smoothed out.

notes.title: Demo Update (Demo v1.4)
notes.notes:
Feature Additions

Added Korean, Japanese, and Chinese languages
Added shortcuts for character and unit selection
Added gamepad control functionality
Added friend-or-foe identification markers
Added transparency effect when characters are obscured by structures

Bug Fixes

Fixed bug where level-up stat increases were the same for all characters
Fixed issue where hyena gang animations were awkward

Balancing Adjustments

Adjusted to start with additional members
Increased base level capacity of all stages by 5
Adjusted base HP for each character and increased overall base attack power
Increased increments of HP, attack power, etc., upon leveling up
